## Descripción
In RSA d is a lot bigger than e, why don't we use d to encrypt instead of e? Connect with `nc chatelaine.cylabacademy.net 29681`.
## Solución
```
┌──(kali㉿kali)-[~]
└─$ mkdir -p ~/b00tl3gRSA2   
                                                                                                                 
┌──(kali㉿kali)-[~]
└─$ cd ~/b00tl3gRSA2 ~/Apps 
cd: string not in pwd: /home/kali/b00tl3gRSA2
                                                                                                                 
┌──(kali㉿kali)-[~]
└─$ cd ~/b00tl3gRSA2       
                                                                                                                 
┌──(kali㉿kali)-[~/b00tl3gRSA2]
└─$ nc -w 5 chatelaine.cylabacademy.net 29681 | tee datos.txt
c: 
n: 
e: 


┌──(kali㉿kali)-[~/b00tl3gRSA2]
└─$ python3 - <<'PY'
heredoc> import re
from pathlib import Path

data = Path('datos.txt').read_text()
c = int(re.search(r'(?m)^c:\s*(\d+)', data).group(1))
n = int(re.search(r'(?m)^n:\s*(\d+)', data).group(1))

m = pow(c, 65537, n)
message = m.to_bytes((m.bit_length() + 7) // 8, 'big')
print(message.decode())
PY
academy{bad_1d3a5_4209105}
```
